exceptions.reason: The retired stylesheet package implicitly loaded preset artifacts. The compiler-owned stylesheet host now receives Manifest v1 explicitly and must not create hidden dependencies on generated preset files.
exceptions.old: Registering @import "@master/css" reports default-manifest.json and default-native.css as style dependencies.
exceptions.new: Registering the equivalent stylesheet with an explicit baseManifest reports neither generated preset artifact as a dependency.

exceptions.reason: The synchronous TypeScript MasterCSS facade was retired. The public @master/css surface now creates an asynchronous Rust-backed engine session and does not restore a compatibility shim.
exceptions.old: @master/css exposes MasterCSS.create({ manifest }) synchronously and returns the same manifest object with empty text.
exceptions.new: @master/css exposes createEngine({ manifest }) asynchronously, selects the native Rust binding, and returns an empty snapshot for an empty manifest.

exceptions.reason: Scanner extraction semantics now live in the owning Rust crate, while the TypeScript host keeps only private first-party framework adapters. Restoring the rc.87 third-party adapter registry would reintroduce a retired public semantic extension API and violate the Rust-only ownership boundary.
exceptions.old: Passing a custom .txt adapter before the built-in adapters extracts the adapter result block instead of the source text class hidden.
exceptions.new: The scanner options reject the retired adapters field and the Rust-backed built-in extraction pipeline observes hidden from the same .txt source.

exceptions.reason: The refactored CLI exposes generation as an explicit command and does not preserve the rc.87 root scanning command shape.
exceptions.old: Root help advertises source paths, watch, and no-export options directly on @master/css-cli.
exceptions.new: Root help advertises the master-css binary with explicit generate, lint, and inspect commands; generation options belong to generate.

exceptions.reason: The CLI refactor removes obsolete extract, render, and scan compatibility shims instead of retaining legacy command-specific errors.
exceptions.old: Invoking extract, render, or scan reports that the named command was removed.
exceptions.new: Invoking extract, render, or scan follows Commander's ordinary unknown-command failure path.

exceptions.reason: The published CLI has one deliberate binary name and does not restore the retired package-name binary representation.
exceptions.old: The package metadata represents the binary as the package-name string form expected by rc.87.
exceptions.new: The package metadata exposes only the master-css binary mapped to dist/bin/index.js.

exceptions.reason: SvelteKit setup delegates to the current canonical addon package and must not restore the retired @master/css-sv package name.
exceptions.old: The generated SvelteKit setup command runs sv add @master/css-sv.
exceptions.new: The generated SvelteKit setup command runs sv add @master/css-svelte-addon.

exceptions.reason: The VS Code server now bundles Rust-backed semantic hosts and externalizes only the target-specific native binding packages. Restoring retired TypeScript semantic dependencies would violate the Rust ownership boundary.
exceptions.old: The server bundle leaves lightningcss and oxc-parser as native runtime imports.
exceptions.new: The server bundle contains no lightningcss or oxc semantic imports; target-specific @master/css-binding packages remain the staged native runtime boundary.

exceptions.reason: Published package entrypoints use named exports unless an ecosystem default is explicitly required. The Shiki subpath keeps the named language registration and does not restore the rc.87 default array export.
exceptions.old: @master/css-language-service/shiki exports an array containing masterCSSShikiLanguage as its default value.
exceptions.new: @master/css-language-service/shiki exports masterCSSShikiLanguage by name and has no default export.

exceptions.reason: The Rust runtime contract treats an explicitly configured external hydration manifest as authoritative input. Silently falling back after an import or payload failure would conceal deployment corruption and undo the refactored error boundary.
exceptions.old: Progressive hydration catches a failed external manifest import and continues with DOM fallback hydration.
exceptions.new: Progressive hydration reports INVALID_HYDRATION_MANIFEST for failed imports or invalid external manifest payloads.

exceptions.reason: The refactored server renderer produces one immutable result from the complete HTML source. Keeping the rc.87 early CSS snapshot would make the final result depend on stream chunk boundaries and omit classes discovered in later chunks.
exceptions.old: The Svelte server hook injects the first safe streaming CSS snapshot and leaves classes from later chunks to client hydration.
exceptions.new: The streaming transform remains incremental, while the final immutable render result includes CSS for classes from every chunk.

exceptions.reason: Rust-owned lint diagnostics consistently render CSS declarations and class names as Markdown code spans. Restoring mixed double-quote delimiters would regress the normalized diagnostic presentation contract.
exceptions.old: Canonical compose diagnostics wrap declarations in backticks but class names in double quotes.
exceptions.new: Canonical compose diagnostics wrap both declarations and class names in escaped backtick code spans.
